UC-470.en: Rename the folder '{name}' so it has no * or ? in its name, then try again. Clauseo can't protect conversations in a folder with those characters.
UC-470.note: matter.folder_wildcard: a * or ? in a folder name of the matter folder's path keeps Claude's sandbox from naming it on macOS or Linux, so the host didn't start Claude; {name} is the deepest such folder in the matter's folder display (the matter folder's own name or one above it), isolated; English settled by the orchestrator; with no folder to name, the line is UC-472's

UC-471.en: Clauseo can't protect conversations here because another matter's folder, or a folder Clauseo keeps its own files in, has * or ? in its name. Rename that folder so it has no * or ?, then try again. If you can't find it, ask your firm's IT.
UC-471.note: agent.sandbox_wildcard: a * or ? in another matter's folder (whose pattern would cover this conversation's folders) or in the path of a folder Clauseo keeps a Claude session's own files in (data, work, temp or notes), so the host didn't start Claude; not retryable

UC-472.en: Clauseo couldn't set up its protection for conversations on this computer, so Claude didn't start. Restart your computer, then try again. If this keeps happening, ask your firm's IT.
UC-472.note: agent.sandbox_unavailable: Claude's sandbox couldn't be set up for another reason (its short temp folder couldn't be made, or a folder to deny isn't UTF-8), so the host didn't start Claude; also matter.folder_wildcard's line when the folder with the * or ? is unknown or out of sight; not retryable
